name: spring-card-stack-swipe
title: Spring Card Stack Swipe
description: A deck of cards that can be dismissed left or right with velocity swipe detection and spring restitution.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Bistable Swipe Dismiss: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
